(rule!
  (let* ((ref (first (find-color g 9)))
         (offsets (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first ref)) (- (second p) (second ref))))
                       (find-color g 8)))
         (anchors (filter (lambda (cell)
                            (member? (third cell) (list 2 3 4 5)))
                          (grid-cells g))))
    (define (anchor-transform color)
      (cond [(= color 2) 0] [(= color 3) 1] [(= color 4) 2] [else 3]))
    (define (paint-color color)
      (cond [(= color 2) 4] [(= color 3) 5] [(= color 4) 6] [else 7]))
    (define (rotate-offset off t)
      (let ((dr (first off)) (dc (second off)))
        (cond [(= t 0) (list dr dc)]
              [(= t 1) (list dc (- dr))]
              [(= t 2) (list (- dr) (- dc))]
              [else (list (- dc) dr)])))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([anchor (in-list anchors)])
      (let ((t (anchor-transform (third anchor)))
            (new-color (paint-color (third anchor)))
            (with-anchor (set-cell out (first anchor) (second anchor) (third anchor))))
        (for/fold ([acc with-anchor]) ([off (in-list offsets)])
          (let* ((rot (rotate-offset off t))
                 (rr (+ (first anchor) (first rot)))
                 (cc (+ (second anchor) (second rot))))
            (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows acc) (cols acc))
                (set-cell acc rr cc (max (at acc rr cc) new-color))
                acc)))))))
